ValidationRule.description: if Credit Pre-Screening Result = Decline then the agent has to fill Pre-screener Decline Reason field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, "Decline"), ISBLANK(cc_Pre_screener_Decline_Reason__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Pre-screener Decline Reason field.
